subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: What permanent Google Chat user OAuth credential and scope model should the bundled plugin expose for reactions, media upload, reaction typing, and proactive DMs?
rationale: The issue is valid, but implementation changes auth/config surface and stores user OAuth secrets, so automation should not choose the product and security shape alone.

options.title: Design plugin-local OAuth
options.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth config/SecretRef shape and operation-specific client routing inside the bundled plugin before implementation.

options.title: Ship media fallback first
options.body: Treat only the 403 upload message-loss symptom as immediate work and leave user OAuth for a later design pass.

options.title: Defer the OAuth surface
options.body: Keep the channel service-account-only until maintainers are ready to own user refresh-token setup and docs.

recommendation.title: Design plugin-local OAuth
recommendation.body: Define a Google Chat user OAuth config/SecretRef shape and operation-specific client routing inside the bundled plugin before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent Google Chat area history and already reviewed this issue as maintainer-side context.
